testcase.name: test_ask_prior_recovery_not_fabricated

failure.message:
AssertionError: fabricated recovery figure: recovery of ₹1,100,000 in No prior recovery amount is available in the current dataset. The imported records show ₹0 previously recovered, and no resolved signals with a confirmed impact amount exist.
What is visible are open findings requiring action: a high-confidence potential duplicate payment to Cloud Vendor of ₹46,000 [rec:csv_030814e60c] [rec:csv_d33f4f0495], and a similarly high-confidence potential duplicate to Ad Network India of ₹27,500 [rec:csv_5c5264ee26] [rec:csv_0dd8ba16af], with the recoverable excess in each case being one payment's worth. Separately, an unbilled services finding against Nova Media [rec:csv_84b9569664] [rec:csv_bf15a587aa] [rec:csv_0067148cbd] carries a potential recovery of ₹1,100,000.
In total, ₹1,100,000 in potential revenue recovery and ₹73,500 in potential profit leak exposure remain open and unactioned. None of this has been recovered yet. assert not <re.Match object; span=(681, 703), match='recovery of ₹1,100,000'>
